{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

missing_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {missing_body_mass}')

# Check the distribution of body_mass_g
print('\nSummary statistics for body_mass_g:')
print(df['body_mass_g'].describe())

# Compute mean, excluding missing values
mean_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f'\nMean body mass (excluding missing values): {mean_body_mass}')"}
